verdict.rationale: Qapita markets tools for legal teams and fractional CFOs managing client equity. However, the evidence never documents scoped, delegated access for authorized third parties: no OAuth, no scoped API tokens, and no role-limited external-party permissions short of admin credentials. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths, so there is also no evidence of a developer-facing authorization model.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
